register_all_cityscapes_panoptic: register all Cityscapes panoptic dataset splits (train, val) to Detectron2 DatasetCatalog with metadata
load_cityscapes_panoptic: load Cityscapes panoptic dataset from image dir, ground truth dir, and JSON annotation file into Detectron2 standard format
get_cityscapes_panoptic_files: scan image and annotation directories to build a list of image-file, label-file, and segments-info tuples
create_cityscapes_panoptic_dataset: create a Detectron2 dataset for Cityscapes panoptic segmentation using registered catalog entries and metadata
convert_category_ids_panoptic: convert Cityscapes panoptic category IDs from original dataset IDs to contiguous training IDs using thing and stuff mappings
